phase1.root_cause: The legacy is_common_stock decision combined security type (ProdCat=011 and preferred-share exclusion) with a hard-coded TSE market allow-list. The same flag controlled both J-Quants requests and Supabase synchronization.

new_contract.is_ordinary_stock: Exchange-independent security classification: ProdCat=011 and not explicitly named as preferred stock.
new_contract.is_jquants_price_eligible: Source-coverage decision: ordinary stock and a current/historical regular TSE market code supported by J-Quants daily bars.

sources.preferred_candidate: Contracted official market-information service or CENTNET
sources.candidate_format: daily PDF; official contracted feed/CENTNET offers additional structured information
sources.url_pattern_observed: official report index links dated PDF files; exact file lifecycle must not be assumed without a contract

fields.turnover: available in market reports; per-security contract/feed definition requires confirmation

sources.history: Daily-report archive and monthly statistics are published; guaranteed depth and retention are not stated.
sources.terms_finding: The exchange states that real-time market-information use requires an information-use contract. Public-site copyright belongs to the exchange and unauthorized alteration or sale is prohibited; this does not grant automated collection, database storage or Viewer redistribution rights.
sources.robots_finding: https://www.nse.or.jp/robots.txt resolves to the exchange NOT FOUND page, so it supplies no affirmative automation permission.

sources.preferred_candidate: Official daily report, subject to written usage confirmation
sources.history: The official archive exposes historical reports, with search-visible samples back to at least 2007; retention is not guaranteed.
sources.terms_finding: The public disclaimer addresses accuracy/liability but does not grant scheduled automated downloading, persistent DB storage, or redistribution in Company Viewer. Daily PDFs state copyright and all rights reserved.
sources.robots_finding: Direct robots.txt access was blocked by the client and no affirmative automation permission was found.
sources.maintenance: high (PDF layout and no adjusted-price series)

sources.preferred_candidate: Official daily report for latest price, subject to written usage confirmation
sources.candidate_format: daily PDF; monthly and annual XLSX
sources.history: Daily PDF archive plus monthly/annual XLSX. Monthly tables are published on the third business day and are unsuitable as the latest-price source.
sources.terms_finding: The exchange asserts copyright and prohibits unauthorized alteration or sale, but gives no affirmative permission for scheduled automated collection, persistent DB storage, or Viewer redistribution.
sources.robots_finding: https://www.fse.or.jp/robots.txt renders the normal home page rather than a robots policy and supplies no affirmative automation permission.
sources.maintenance: medium-high (PDF for freshness; XLSX only for delayed monthly history; no adjusted-price series)

canonical_contract.raw_price_policy: Official exchange OHLC/close remains unadjusted raw price.
canonical_contract.adjusted_price_policy: adj_factor, adj_close and adj_volume must remain NULL until a verified corporate-action adjustment source and policy exist.
canonical_contract.dual_listing_policy: Never overwrite TSE/J-Quants rows with a regional fallback.
canonical_contract.unresolved_pipeline_boundary: sync_market_data.py currently filters through the J-Quants universe and hard-codes source=jquants; regional-source synchronization requires an explicit source-aware gate before any DB canary.

stop_gate.reason: Automation, persistent storage, and Viewer redistribution rights are not explicitly granted by the official public terms for all three exchanges. Nagoya additionally documents a contracted market-information channel.
stop_gate.required_next_action: Obtain written confirmation or contracts from each exchange covering scheduled download, internal DB storage, derived valuation display, and external Viewer display/redistribution.

known_preexisting_contamination.description: Legacy 4180/41800 price rows are stored under 418A. This audit neither reads them as a regional canary nor cleans them up.
